name: tn_retrieval
notes: 48 TN questions (spec 10.7): 25 French, 5 English, 6 Arabic script, 4 transliterated, 4 code-switched, 4 out of scope. Gold = quoted spans of the current documents (eval.resolve_gold). See eval/datasets/README.md.

name: tn_retrieval
notes: v1 plus pooled judgments: every passage in the top 10 of any of the 12 runs of job 92e8c6cd judged (1,060 merged regions), relevant ones added, shared within need groups; 304 gold spans (89 in v1). See eval/datasets/README.md and D-052.

name: p1_router
notes: 160 synthetic messages for P1 (spec 9.5): fr 34, en 24, ar 14, Tunisian in Arabic script 16, Tunisian arabizi 22, code-switched 22, de 10, es 9, it 9; 18 injection, 12 mixed-intent, 10 ambiguous. Guide: eval/datasets/guides/p1_router.md. Model-written and model-labelled (D-055).

name: p2_profile
notes: 110 synthetic search requests for P2 (spec 9.5): TN 55, FR 30, GB 25; 52 unit traps, 21 without budget, 22 protected preferences, 49 relative dates. Guide: eval/datasets/guides/p2_profile.md. Model-written and model-labelled (D-055).

name: p3_listing
notes: 100 synthetic listings for P3 (spec 9.5): TN 50, FR 25, GB 25; fr 30, en 25, ar 10, Tunisian in Arabic script 10, arabizi 15, code-switched 10; 34 unit traps, 24 rent-scope traps, 15 without price, 6 injection, 6 discriminatory. Amounts in main units. Guide: eval/datasets/guides/p3_listing.md. Model-written and model-labelled (D-055); 7 labels adjudicated after the blind re-label.

name: p7_photos
notes: 50 room photos from Wikimedia Commons for P7 (spec 9.5, 11.2): bedrooms 13, living rooms 10, other rooms 9 (hallway, balcony, terrace, studio, rooms under works), not a room 7 (building fronts, an object, floor plans, a 3D render), bathrooms 6, kitchens 5; 9 with readable text, 5 with people, 5 dark, 5 in poor condition. CC0, public domain, CC BY or CC BY-SA, source and author per photo. Images are not in the repository (D-069). Labelled from the blurred copies by a model-based annotator (guide eval/datasets/guides/p7_photos.md), 20% re-labelled blind, 8 labels adjudicated.

name: trust
notes: 100 synthetic TN listings for the trust check (backend spec 9.5, P4): 72 honest (16 that look risky on purpose, 6 with text asking to be flagged) and 28 scams written from the signal descriptions of spec 12.2 (21 ask for payment before a visit in the text; 6 ask the model to pass them). French, Arabic, English, Tunisian in Latin letters. Labels from construction, written before any run (build_trust_v1.py). Run on the PC with scripts/trust_bench.py.

name: document_agent
notes: 16 requests to the Document agent (A6, D-108) for a TN household with two flatmates: the kind expected, the values the person gave (dates, notice) and the slots that must still be missing; one request asks for a clause (no text may be added), one for a rent receipt and one legal question (not made here). Labels written with the set, before any run. Run on the PC with scripts/document_bench.py.

name: p8_scam
notes: By Emna Safer (branch feat/scam-check, 2026-10-16), brought in with D-114. 50 synthetic listings for P8_scam_detector: 25 scam, 25 honest; fr 19, en 15, ar 8, arabizi 5, code-switched 3; 13 hard negatives, 4 subtle scams, 3 injection, 1 price trap. Gold = signal types, is_scam (text-only weight >= review threshold of her scale) and amounts. Guide: eval/datasets/guides/p8_scam.md. Model-written and model-labelled (D-055). Written apart from the phrase lists of the trust check, so it is a second, independent set for scripts/trust_bench.py.

name: flatmate_onboarding
notes: 20 first messages to the flatmate profile agent (A7, D-115), one new TN user each: fr 10 (one arabizi, one code-switched), en 5, ar 3; 2 with nothing to extract, 3 injections. Gold = the fields the message states and their values; forbidden = fields the message does not give (an invented budget or area). Written by us with the set, before any run; no second annotator.
